_comment: Adding an entry is a ruling routed to @system_adamic. Valid, type-correct programs must never be listed. Schema: witnesses maps SHA-256 of exact source bytes to ruling_task, declaration (file:line), declared_type, repair_from, repair_to, type_correct_sha256, exit (70), stderr (exact bytes; {root} expands to the head checkout). Repair replaces every repair_from with repair_to; its hash can never be listed. Supported literal type lies are string = undefined!/null! and number asserted from a callback returning the string literal wrong. No name lookup; an edit requires Node agreement or a new ruling.
